name: Frasers Property Limited
summary: Frasers Property Limited (Frasers Property and together with its subsidiaries, the Frasers Property Group or the Group), is a multinational investor-developer operator. For real estate products and services. The Group has total assets of approximately S39.7 billion dollars as at 30 September 2025. Frasers Property operates across five asset classes: industrial & logistics, retail, commercial & business parks, residential and hospitality. Its businesses span Southeast Asia, Australia, Europe and China, and its well-established hospitality business owns and/or operates serviced apartments and hotels in 20 countries.
